typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	INMCDMigrationDate as timestamp (),
	OracleDataSource as string (),
	OraclePassword as string (),
	OracleProvider as string (),
	OracleUserID as string (),
	SQLDataSource as string (),
	SQLInitialCatalog as string (),
	SQLPassword as string (),
	SQLProvider as string (),
	SQLUserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		RID as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT as string,
		MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE as string,
		MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE as string,
		STOP_REASON_CODE as string,
		IMPORT_DATE as string,
		ELIG_TYPE as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		PLAN_CHANGE_TO as string,
		MCE_EFF_DT as string,
		MCE_TERM_DT as string,
		START_REASON_CODE as string,
		TAPE_DATE as string,
		INSERTED_DT as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT IE.Medicaid_ID AS RID      , IE.File_Prefix AS ELIG_TYPE                 , IE.Member_First_Name AS FIRST_NAME                 , IE.Member_Last_Name AS LAST_NAME                 , IE.Maintenance_Type_Code AS MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE      , IE.Maintenance_Reason_Code AS MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE                 , IE.Plan_Change_To AS PLAN_CHANGE_TO                 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST(IE.MCE_Begin_Date AS DATE),101) AS MCE_EFF_DT                 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST(IE.MCE_End_Date AS DATE),101) AS MCE_TERM_DT                 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST(IE.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date AS DATE),101) AS BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT                 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST(IE.Benefit_Period_End_Date AS DATE),101) AS BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT                 , IE.Start_Reason_Code AS START_REASON_CODE                 , IE.Stop_Reason_Code AS STOP_REASON_CODE                 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),CAST(IE.ImportDate AS DATE),120) AS IMPORT_DATE                 , CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),CAST(IE.TapeDate AS DATE),120) AS TAPE_DATE 				, GETDATE() AS INSERTED_DT FROM dbo.Indiana_Enrollment IE WITH (NOLOCK) left join (select             IE1.Medicaid_ID,             IE1.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date,              IE1.TapeDate,                                     IE1.ImportDate,                                                 IE1.Start_Reason_Code,                                                 IE1.Stop_Reason_Code,                                                 IE1.Maintenance_Reason_Code,                                                 IE1.Maintenance_Type_Code,                                                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IE1.Medicaid_ID,IE1.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date ORDER BY IE1.TapeDate,IE1.ImportDate,IE1.Start_Reason_Code,IE1.Stop_Reason_Code,IE1.Maintenance_Reason_Code,IE1.Maintenance_Type_Code) ROWNUM                     FROM dbo.Indiana_Enrollment IE1 where IE1.File_Prefix = \'HIPFE\' 					and  IE1.Medicaid_ID in (select RID from [dbo].[PRF_INCLUSION_STG_ENROLL])                                                                                                 ) IE_MIN             ON IE_MIN.Medicaid_ID=IE.Medicaid_ID              AND IE_MIN.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date=IE.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date                                                 AND IE_MIN.TapeDate=IE.TapeDate                                                 AND IE_MIN.ImportDate=IE.ImportDate                                                 AND IE_MIN.Start_Reason_Code=IE.Start_Reason_Code                                                 AND IE_MIN.Stop_Reason_Code=IE.Stop_Reason_Code                                                 AND IE_MIN.Maintenance_Reason_Code=IE.Maintenance_Reason_Code                                                 AND IE_MIN.Maintenance_Type_Code=IE.Maintenance_Type_Code left join (select             IE1.Medicaid_ID,             IE1.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date,              IE1.TapeDate,                                     IE1.ImportDate,                                                 IE1.Start_Reason_Code,                                                 IE1.Stop_Reason_Code,                                                 IE1.Maintenance_Reason_Code,                                                 IE1.Maintenance_Type_Code,                                                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IE1.Medicaid_ID,IE1.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date ORDER BY IE1.TapeDate desc,IE1.ImportDate desc,IE1.Start_Reason_Code desc,IE1.Stop_Reason_Code desc,IE1.Maintenance_Reason_Code desc,IE1.Maintenance_Type_Code desc)                ROWNUM                                FROM dbo.Indiana_Enrollment IE1 where IE1.File_Prefix = \'HIPFE\' 					and  IE1.Medicaid_ID in (select RID from [dbo].[PRF_INCLUSION_STG_ENROLL])                                                 ) IE_MAX              ON IE_MAX.Medicaid_ID=IE.Medicaid_ID              AND IE_MAX.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date=IE.Benefit_Period_Begin_Date                                                  AND IE_MAX.TapeDate=IE.TapeDate                                                 AND IE_MAX.ImportDate=IE.ImportDate                                                 AND IE_MAX.Start_Reason_Code=IE.Start_Reason_Code                                                 AND IE_MAX.Stop_Reason_Code=IE.Stop_Reason_Code                                                 AND IE_MAX.Maintenance_Reason_Code=IE.Maintenance_Reason_Code                                                 AND IE_MAX.Maintenance_Type_Code=IE.Maintenance_Type_Code                                                 WHERE (IE_MAX.ROWNUM=1 OR IE_MIN.ROWNUM=1)                                                 AND IE.File_Prefix = \'HIPFE\' and  IE.Medicaid_ID in (select RID from [dbo].[PRF_INCLUSION_STG_ENROLL]) ORDER BY IE.Medicaid_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ENROLLIndianaEnrollData	source(output(
		RID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT RID FROM AGP.PRF_ELIG_MEMBERS_STAGING PRFE ORDER BY PRFE.RID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GBDPRFEligibleData
GBDPRFEligibleData,ENROLLIndianaEnrollData join(GBDPRFEligibleData@RID == ENROLLIndianaEnrollData@RID,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MERGEJOIN
MERGEJOIN select(mapColumn(
		MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE = MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE,
		MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE = MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE,
		STOP_REASON_CODE = STOP_REASON_CODE,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT = BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT = BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
		IMPORT_DATE = IMPORT_DATE,
		ELIG_TYPE = ELIG_TYPE,
		FIRST_NAME = FIRST_NAME,
		LAST_NAME = LAST_NAME,
		PLAN_CHANGE_TO = PLAN_CHANGE_TO,
		MCE_EFF_DT = MCE_EFF_DT,
		MCE_TERM_DT = MCE_TERM_DT,
		START_REASON_CODE = START_REASON_CODE,
		TAPE_DATE = TAPE_DATE,
		INSERTED_DT = INSERTED_DT,
		RID = ENROLLIndianaEnrollData@RID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MERGEJOINSelect
MERGEJOINSelect derive(MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE = MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE,
		MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE = MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE,
		STOP_REASON_CODE = STOP_REASON_CODE,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT = BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT = BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
		IMPORT_DATE = IMPORT_DATE,
		ELIG_TYPE = ELIG_TYPE,
		FIRST_NAME = FIRST_NAME,
		LAST_NAME = LAST_NAME,
		PLAN_CHANGE_TO = PLAN_CHANGE_TO,
		MCE_EFF_DT = MCE_EFF_DT,
		MCE_TERM_DT = MCE_TERM_DT,
		START_REASON_CODE = START_REASON_CODE,
		TAPE_DATE = TAPE_DATE,
		INSERTED_DT = INSERTED_DT,
		RID = RID) ~> MERGEJOINREFORMAT1
MERGEJOINREFORMAT1 sink(input(
		MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE as string,
		MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE as string,
		STOP_REASON_CODE as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT as string,
		IMPORT_DATE as string,
		ELIG_TYPE as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		PLAN_CHANGE_TO as string,
		MCE_EFF_DT as string,
		MCE_TERM_DT as string,
		START_REASON_CODE as string,
		TAPE_DATE as string,
		INSERTED_DT as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		RID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE,
		MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE,
		STOP_REASON_CODE,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
		IMPORT_DATE,
		ELIG_TYPE,
		FIRST_NAME,
		LAST_NAME,
		PLAN_CHANGE_TO,
		MCE_EFF_DT,
		MCE_TERM_DT,
		START_REASON_CODE,
		TAPE_DATE,
		INSERTED_DT,
		RID)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderPRFENROLLMENTSTAGING
